changelog: **Mobile app: every way into messages opens the native screen, and the keyboard no longer hides the composer** (#2775). One rule (`apps/mobile/src/lib/nativeRoutes.ts`, unit-tested) maps `/messages/c/<id>` to the native thread and `/messages` and `/notifications` to their tabs. A script injected before the page's own stops a link tap before the site's router sees it, reports a `router.push()` (the "send message" buttons) or a redirect's `replaceState` (legacy `/messages/<relationId>`) and undoes it with `history.back()`, and `onShouldStartLoadWithRequest` refuses a full load; a notification tap asks the same rule. A thread opened from a link names itself (`threadTitle`). The keyboard: the app draws edge to edge, so React Native's `KeyboardAvoidingView` did nothing on Android; the thread now follows the keyboard's height through `react-native-keyboard-controller`, and sign-in uses that library's `KeyboardAvoidingView`. `react-native-reanimated`/`react-native-worklets` became direct dependencies at the SDK's versions (they were already linked through expo-router, with a worklets version mismatch).
